65700.meaning2: epithet of Sakka; lit. having a diamond mace in his hand
65700.synonym: makhādeva, magghadeva, maghadeva, māgha, vāsava, sahassakkha, sahassanetta, sujampati
65700.commentary: (DNa) jitā vajirahatthenā'ti indena devaraññā jitā. (APt) vajiraṃ hatthe yassa so vajirahattho.

examples.text: jitā vajirahatthena, samuddaṃ asur'āsitā, bhātaro vāsavass'ete, iddhimanto yasassino.
atha kho māro pāpimā jānāti maṃ vajirā bhikkhunī'ti dukkhī dummano tatth'ev'antaradhāyī'ti.

65703.meaning1: name of a princess; daughter of king Pasenadi

examples.text: atha kho mallikā devī yena rājā pasenadi kosalo ten'upasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā rājānaṃ pasenadiṃ kosalaṃ etadavoca, taṃ kiṃ maññasi, mahārāja, piyā te vajirī kumārī'ti? evaṃ, mallike, piyā me vajirī kumārī'ti.

65704.commentary: (ANa) vajir'ūpamacitto'ti kilesānaṃ mūlaghātakaraṇasamatthatāya vajirena sadisacitto. (BVa) vajir'ūpaman'ti vajirasadisaṃ tikhiṇaṃ, anicc'ānupassan'ādikassa vipassanāñāṇass'etaṃ adhivacanaṃ.

examples.text: aruk'ūpamacitto puggalo, vijj'ūpamacitto puggalo, vajir'ūpamacitto puggalo.
tattha ñāṇavar'uppajji, anantaṃ vajir'ūpamaṃ, tena vicini saṅkhāre, ukkujjam'avakujjakaṃ.
katamo ca, bhikkhave, vajir'ūpamacitto puggalo? idha, bhikkhave, ekacco puggalo āsavānaṃ khayā anāsavaṃ cetovimuttiṃ paññāvimuttiṃ diṭṭh'eva dhamme sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja viharati.
sabbaso nāmarūpasmiṃ, vītagedhassa brāhmaṇa, āsavā'ssa na vijjanti, yehi maccuvasaṃ vaje'ti.

65708.synonym: bhāṇī, bhāsī, vadanta, vadamāna, vadū, vadenta, vādaka, vādī

examples.text: māno hi te brāhmaṇa khāribhāro, kodho dhūmo bhasmani mosavajjaṃ, jivhā sujā hadayaṃ jotiṭhānaṃ, attā sudanto purisassa joti.
cattār'imāni, bhikkhave, saṅgahavatthūni. katamāni cattāri? dānaṃ, peyyavajjaṃ, atthacariyā, samān'attatā, imāni kho, bhikkhave, cattāri saṅgahavatthūnī'ti.

65709.grammar: opt 2nd sg of vajjā, irreg conjugation, trans (+acc)
65709.meaning1: you could say; you should tell

examples.text: ehi sārathi gacchāhi, rathaṃ niyyādayāh'imaṃ, ārogyaṃ brāhmaṇiṃ vajja, pabbaji dāni brāhmaṇo, sujāto tīhi rattīhi, tisso vijjā aphassayi.
sudassaṃ vajjam'aññesaṃ, attano pana duddasaṃ, paresaṃ hi so vajjāni, opunāti yathā bhusaṃ, attano pana chādeti, kaliṃ'va kitavā saṭho.
sīlavā hoti, pātimokkhasaṃvarasaṃvuto viharati ācāragocarasampanno aṇumattesu vajjesu bhayadassāvī, samādāya sikkhati sikkhāpadesu.
dibbāni'pi tūriyāni antalikkhe vajjanti tathāgatassa pūjāya. dibbāni'pi saṅgītāni antalikkhe vattanti tathāgatassa pūjāya.

65714.grammar: ind, adv, abl sg of vajja
65714.meaning1: as faulty; as an error; as a mistake

examples.text: vajjañ'ca vajjato ñatvā, avajjañ'ca avajjato, sammādiṭṭhisamādānā, sattā gacchanti suggatiṃ.
nidhīnaṃ'va pavattāraṃ, yaṃ passe vajjadassinaṃ, niggayhavādiṃ medhāviṃ, tādisaṃ paṇḍitaṃ bhaje, tādisaṃ bhajamānassa, seyyo hoti na pāpiyo.

65717.meaning1: (vinaya) who should be avoided; who should be excluded
65717.meaning2: fit to be avoided or shunned

examples.text: vajjanīyā ca puggalā tasmiṃ na honti kiṃ? gahaṭṭhapaṇḍak'ādayo ekavīsati vajjanīyā puggalā hatthapāsato bahikaraṇavasena vajjetabbā. te asmiṃ na honti.
examples.source: VIN PAT PK saṅghuposatha pubbakaraṇādi vidhi

examples.text: uposatho, yāvatikā ca bhikkhū kammappattā, sabhāg'āpattiyo ca na vijjanti, vajjanīyā ca puggalā tasmiṃ na honti pattakallan'ti vuccati.
examples.source: VIN PAT PK saṅghuposatha pubbakaraṇādi vidhi

examples.text: kathañ'ca, bhikkhave, puggalo vajjabahulo hoti? idha, bhikkhave, ekacco puggalo sāvajjena bahulaṃ kāyakammena samannāgato hoti, appaṃ anavajjena, sāvajjena bahulaṃ vacīkammena samannāgato hoti, appaṃ anavajjena, sāvajjena bahulaṃ manokammena samannāgato hoti, appaṃ anavajjena.

imāni kho, bhikkhave, dve vajjāni. tasmā't'iha, bhikkhave, evaṃ sikkhitabbaṃ, diṭṭhadhammikassa vajjassa bhāyissāma, samparāyikassa vajjassa bhāyissāma, vajjabhīruno bhavissāma vajjabhayadassāvino'ti. evañ'hi vo, bhikkhave, sikkhitabbaṃ.

65722.meaning1: fearful of faults; cautious of mistakes

examples.text: imāni kho, bhikkhave, dve vajjāni. tasmā't'iha, bhikkhave, evaṃ sikkhitabbaṃ, diṭṭhadhammikassa vajjassa bhāyissāma, samparāyikassa vajjassa bhāyissāma, vajjabhīruno bhavissāma vajjabhayadassāvino'ti. evañ'hi vo, bhikkhave, sikkhitabbaṃ.

65723.meaning1: perceiving fault (in); believing to be a mistake; thinking to be faulty

examples.text: avajje vajjamatino, vajje c'āvajjadassino, micchādiṭṭhisamādānā, sattā gacchanti duggatiṃ.

65726.meaning1: at fault; in error; with mistakes

examples.text: so evaṃ pajānāti, n'atthi nu kho taṃ kiñci lokasmiṃ yam'ahaṃ upādiyamāno na vajjavā assaṃ.

65727.grammar: opt, reflx 1st sg of vajjā, irreg conjugation, trans (+acc)

examples.text: passāmi vītivattantaṃ, brahmaloke pabhassaraṃ, so'haṃ ajja kathaṃ vajjaṃ, ahaṃ nicco'mhi sassato.

65728.commentary: (SNa) yena naṃ vajjā'ti yena naṃ rāgena ratto'ti vā dosena duṭṭho'ti vā mohena mūḷho'ti vā'ti koci vadeyya, taṃ kāraṇaṃ tassa khīṇ'āsavassa n'atthi.

examples.text: annañ'ca laddhā vasanañ'ca kāle, mattaṃ so jaññā idha tosan'atthaṃ, so tesu gutto yatacāri gāme, rusito'pi vācaṃ pharusaṃ na vajjā.
akkheyyañ'ca pariññāya, akkhātāraṃ na maññati, tañ'hi tassa na hotī'ti, yena naṃ vajjā na tassa atthi.

65729.meaning1: business affair of the Vajjīs; Vajjian duty
65729.meaning2: business affair of the Vajjīs; Vajjian duty
65729.commentary: (ANa) ekassa pana kamm'ante osīdamāne sesā puttabhātaro pesetvā tassa kamm'antaṃ upatthambhayamānā'pi āgantukarājānaṃ asukassa gehaṃ gacchatu, asukassa gehaṃ gacchatū'ti avatvā sabbe ekato saṅgaṇhantā'pi ekassa maṅgale vā roge vā aññasmiṃ vā pana tādise sukhadukkhe uppanne sabbe tattha sahāyabhāvaṃ gacchantā'pi samaggā vajjikaraṇīyāni karonti nāma.

examples.text: yāvakīvañ'ca, ānanda, vajjī samaggā sannipatissanti, samaggā vuṭṭhahissanti, samaggā vajjikaraṇīyāni karissanti, vuddhi'y'eva, ānanda, vajjīnaṃ pāṭikaṅkhā, no parihāni.
atthi, bhante, pubbavijjanaṃ nāma vajjigāmo. tatth'āyasmato channassa mittakulāni suhajjakulāni upavajjakulānī'ti.

65731.commentary: (DNa) vajjīnaṃ vajjicetiyānī'ti vajjirājūnaṃ vajjiraṭṭhe cittīkat'aṭṭhena cetiyānī'ti laddhanāmāni yakkhaṭṭhānāni.

examples.text: sutaṃ m'etaṃ, bhante, vajjī yāni tāni vajjīnaṃ vajjicetiyāni abbhantarāni c'eva bāhirāni ca, tāni sakkaronti garuṃ karonti mānenti pūjenti tesañ'ca dinnapubbaṃ katapubbaṃ dhammikaṃ baliṃ no parihāpentī'ti.

65735.meaning1: Vajjian principle; law of the Vajjīs
65735.meaning2: Vajjian principle; law of the Vajjīs

examples.text: sutaṃ m'etaṃ, bhante, vajjī apaññattaṃ na paññapenti, paññattaṃ na samucchindanti, yathāpaññatte porāṇe vajjidhamme samādāya vattantī'ti.
lābhā vata, bhante, vajjīnaṃ, suladdhalābhā vajjipajāya, yattha tathāgato viharati arahaṃ sammāsambuddho, ime ca tayo kulaputtā, āyasmā ca anuruddho, āyasmā ca nandiyo, āyasmā ca kimilo'ti.
vajjiputto ca vesālī, sajjhāyena ayoniso, majjhanhikālamhi pākatindriya, padumapupphena cuddasa bhave'ti.
ekaṃ samayaṃ aññataro vajjiputtako bhikkhu vesāliyaṃ viharati aññatarasmiṃ vanasaṇḍe.

65743.meaning1: Vajjian region; land of the Vajjians

examples.text: māgadhaṃ gatā kosalaṃ gatā, ekacciyā pana vajjibhūmiyā, magā viya asaṅgacārino, aniketā viharanti bhikkhavo'ti.

65744.meaning1: people of Vajjī and Malla; Vajjians and Mallans

examples.text: tena kho pana samayena bhagavā parito parito janapadesu paricārake abbhatīte kālaṅ'kate upapattīsu byākaroti kāsikosalesu vajjimallesu cetivaṃsesu kurupañcālesu majjhasūrasenesu
sutaṃ m'etaṃ, bhante, vajjī ye te vajjīnaṃ vajjimahallakā, te sakkaronti garuṃ karonti mānenti pūjenti, tesañ'ca sotabbaṃ maññantī'ti.
ekam'antaṃ ṭhito kho dīgho parajano yakkho bhagavantaṃ etadavoca, lābhā vata, bhante, vajjīnaṃ, suladdhalābhā vajjipajāya, yattha tathāgato viharati arahaṃ sammāsambuddho, ime ca tayo kulaputtā
ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā vajjīsu viharati ukkacelāyaṃ gaṅgāya nadiyā tīre mahatā bhikkhusaṅghena saddhiṃ aciraparinibbutesu sāriputtamoggallānesu.
ekam'antaṃ ṭhito kho dīgho parajano yakkho bhagavantaṃ etadavoca, lābhā vata, bhante, vajjīnaṃ, suladdhalābhā vajjipajāya, yattha tathāgato viharati arahaṃ sammāsambuddho, ime ca tayo kulaputtā
atthi, bhante, pubbavijjanaṃ nāma vajjigāmo. tatth'āyasmato channassa mittakulāni suhajjakulāni upavajjakulānī'ti.

65752.meaning1: name of a country; capitals Vesali & Mithila
65752.commentary: (THIa) ciṇṇā aṅgā ca magadhā'ti ye ime aṅgā ca magadhā ca vajjī ca kāsī ca kosalā ca janapadā pubbe sāṇāya mayā raṭṭhapiṇḍaṃ bhuñjantiyā ciṇṇā caritā

examples.text: ciṇṇā aṅgā ca magadhā, vajjī kāsī ca kosalā, anaṇā paṇṇāsavassāni, raṭṭhapiṇḍaṃ abhuñj'ahaṃ.

65754.grammar: opt 3rd pl of vajjā, irreg conjugation, trans (+acc)

examples.text: atthaṅ'gatassa na pamāṇam'atthi, yena naṃ vajjuṃ taṃ tassa n'atthi, sabbesu dhammesu samohatesu, samūhatā vādapathā'pi sabbe'ti.
yena naṃ vajjuṃ puthujjanā, atho samaṇabrāhmaṇā, taṃ tassa apurakkhataṃ, tasmā vādesu n'ejati.

65755.meaning1: should be avoided; should be abstained from; to be shunned
65755.meaning2: should be avoided; should be abstained from

examples.text: gahaṭṭhapaṇḍak'ādayo ekavīsati vajjanīyā puggalā hatthapāsato bahikaraṇavasena vajjetabbā. te asmiṃ na honti.
examples.source: VIN PAT PK saṅghuposatha pubbakaraṇādi vidhi

examples.text: kālo hi bhūtānaṃ na cammamaṃs'ādīni khādati, apica kho nesaṃ āyuvaṇṇabalāni khepento yobbaññaṃ maddanto ārogyaṃ vināsento ghasati khādatī'ti vuccati. sabbān'eva sahattanā'ti evaṃ ghasanto ca na kiñci vajjeti, sabbān'eva ghasati. na kevalañ'ca bhūtāni'y'eva, apica kho sahattanā attānam'pi ghasati.

65757.meaning2: to avoid, to abstain from, to renounce

65758.meaning2: having avoided, having abstained from, having renounced

65760.meaning1: who should be killed; to be executed
65760.meaning2: fit to be killed or punished

examples.text: taṃ alabhantena sukhito'pi pāpakārī puggalo vajjhena upametvā karuṇāyitabbo.
orabbhikā sūkarikā, macchikā migabandhakā, corā ca vajjhaghātā ca, ye c'aññe pāpakammino, dak'ābhisecanā te'pi, pāpakammā pamuccare.

65762.meaningLit: killer of those to be killed

examples.text: orabbhikā sūkarikā, macchikā migabandhakā, corā ca vajjhaghātā ca, ye c'aññe pāpakammino, dak'ābhisecanā te'pi, pāpakammā pamuccare.

65763.meaning1: be injured; be killed; be slaughtered; be slain

examples.text: byāpannacitto kho pana hoti paduṭṭhamanasaṅkappo, ime sattā haññantu vā vajjhantu vā ucchijjantu vā vinassantu vā mā vā ahesun'ti.
kitavass'evā'ti vañcakassa kerāṭikassa gumbagacchasaññāya araññe āgat'āgate sakuṇe gahetvā jīvitakappakassa sākuṇikass'eva.
tulākūṭa kaṃsakūṭa mānakūṭa ukkoṭana vañcana nikati sāciyoga chedana vadha bandhana viparāmosa ālopa sāhasākārā paṭivirato ahosi.
tesaṃ māyāvino dāsā, āguṃ vañcanikā saṭhā, māyā kuṭeṇḍu viṭeṇḍu, viṭucca viṭuṭo saha.
nekatikā vañcanikā, kūṭasakkhī apāṭukā, bahūhi parikappehi, āmisaṃ paribhuñjare.

tañ'ca naṃ purisaṃ amittato'pi daheyya, paccatthikato'pi daheyya, api ca jīvitā voropetabbaṃ maññeyya, dīgharattaṃ vata, bho, ahaṃ iminā purisena telamalikatena sāhuḷicīrena nikato vañcito paluddho, idaṃ te, ambho purisa, odātaṃ vatthaṃ abhirūpaṃ nimmalaṃ sucī'ti.
jit'amhā vata bho ambapālikāya vañcit'amhā vata bho ambapālikāyā'ti.
tam'enaṃ aññataro puriso telamalikatena sāhuḷicīrena vañceyya, idaṃ te, ambho purisa, odātaṃ vatthaṃ abhirūpaṃ nimmalaṃ sucī'ti. so taṃ paṭiggaṇheyya, paṭiggahetvā pārupeyya.
yo brāhmaṇaṃ vā samaṇaṃ vā, aññaṃ vā'pi vanibbakaṃ, musāvādena vañceti, taṃ parābhavato mukhaṃ.

65776.commentary: (MNa) vañjhā'ti vañjhapasuvañjhatāl'ādayo viya aphalā, kassaci ajanakā'ti attho. etena pathavīkāy'ādīnaṃ rūp'ādijanakabhāvaṃ paṭikkhipati.

examples.text: satt'ime kāyā akaṭā akaṭavidhā animmitā animmātā vañjhā kūṭaṭṭhā esikaṭṭhāyiṭṭhitā, te na iñjanti na vipariṇamanti na aññam'aññaṃ byābādhenti n'ālaṃ aññam'aññassa sukhāya vā dukkhāya vā sukhadukkhāya vā.

65783.commentary: (THa) vicitta-vāneyya-vaṭaṃsakānan'ti vane jātattā vāneyyāni vanapupphāni, vicittāni vāneyyāni vaṭaṃsakāni etāsan'ti vicittavāneyyavaṭaṃsakā nadiyo, tāsaṃ nānāvidha-vanapuppha-vaṭaṃsakānan'ti attho.

examples.text: yadā nadīnaṃ kusum'ākulānaṃ, vicitta-vāneyya-vaṭaṃsakānaṃ, tīre nisinno sumano'va jhāyati, tato ratiṃ paramataraṃ na vindati.

evaṃ, bho, purato kantāre mahāmegho abhippavuṭṭho, āsitt'odakāni vaṭumāni, bahu tiṇañ'ca kaṭṭhañ'ca udakañ'ca. chaḍḍetha, bho, purāṇāni tiṇāni kaṭṭhāni udakāni, lahubhārehi sakaṭehi sīghaṃ sīghaṃ gacchatha, mā yoggāni kilamitthā'ti.
so'haṃ tadeva punappunaṃ, vaṭumaṃ ācarissāmi sobhane, ariyācaritaṃ sukosale, arahanto me manāpā'va passituṃ.
samavaṭṭakkhandho kho pana so bhavaṃ gotamo, idam'pi tassa bhoto gotamassa mahāpurisassa mahāpurisalakkhaṇaṃ bhavati.
sāmantā sugatavidatthi ādātabbā dubbaṇṇakaraṇāyā'ti thirabhāvāya vaṭṭaṃ vā caturassaṃ vā chinditvā ekadese vā santharitabbaṃ vijaṭetvā vā santharitabbaṃ.
ye ca kho keci, bhikkhave, samaṇā vā brāhmaṇā vā… rūpassa nibbidā virāgā nirodhā anupādā vimuttā, te suvimuttā. ye suvimuttā, te kevalino. ye kevalino vaṭṭaṃ tesaṃ n'atthi paññāpanāya.
yo'pi c'ettha katakusalo hoti, tam'pi ñātirogabhogabyasan'ādīnaṃ aññatarena byasanena samannāgataṃ disvā vā sutvā vā tesaṃ abhāve'pi vaṭṭadukkhaṃ anatikkantattā, dukkhito'va ayan'ti.

65789.meaning2: term for dependent origination as arising

examples.text: seyyathā'pi, anuruddhā, puriso vaṭṭakaṃ sithilaṃ gaṇheyya, so tassa hatthato uppateyya, evam'eva kho me, anuruddhā, atilīnavīriyaṃ udapādi, atilīnavīriy'ādhikaraṇañ'ca pana me samādhi cavi. samādhimhi cute obhāso antaradhāyati dassanañ'ca rūpānaṃ.

65799.meaning2: behoves, is right, fit, or proper
